say:1:1660002001:0.text: You and Gerda make your way to the springs. The capybaras that usually lounge here are nowhere to be seen. A few guests have gathered, watching two figures at work...
say:1:1660002001:0.source_cn: 你和格尔达来到露天温泉，往日悠闲游憩的水豚不见踪影，住...
say:1:1660002001:0.male: You and Gerda make your way to the springs. The capybaras that usually lounge here are nowhere to be seen. A few guests have gathered, watching two figures at work...
say:1:1660002001:0.female: You and Gerda make your way to the springs. The capybaras that usually lounge here are nowhere to be seen. A few guests have gathered, watching two figures at work...

say:3:1660002002:1.text: The springs are still closed? It's been days already...
say:3:1660002002:1.source_cn: 温泉还不能开放吗？这都多少天了……

say:4:1660002003:1.text: I'm still clearing the area, but... even when that's done, I doubt the spring will be ready anytime soon.
say:4:1660002003:1.source_cn: 嗯……虽然我接下来要去铲周围的雪，但估计就算弄完了也暂...

say:5:1660002004:1.text: How long is this gonna take, exactly?

say:6:1660002005:1.text: The snow itself isn't the issue...
say:6:1660002005:1.source_cn: 单清扫的话，倒是不太久……

say:9:1660002006:1.text: As he speaks, the silver-haired girl beside him lifts her staff. The snow around them rises at once, piling up like a small mountain before sweeping off toward the cliff.
say:9:1660002006:1.source_cn: 男子话音刚落，旁边的银发女子就挥动了法杖。四周的积雪立...

say:11:1660002007:0.text: All clear. Now I'm freezing... and starving.
say:11:1660002007:0.source_cn: 搞定了。呜……好冷啊。肚子饿扁了——

choice_prompt:12:1660002007.text: All clear. Now I'm freezing... and starving.
choice_prompt:12:1660002007.source_cn: 好冷……清理好了。辛美尔，是不是可以去吃东西了？

say:13:1660002008:1.text: See? Told you they could handle it!
say:13:1660002008:1.source_cn: 哈哈，我就说他们很能干吧！
say:13:1660002008:1.male: See? Told you they could handle it!
say:13:1660002008:1.female: See? Told you they could handle it!

say:15:1660002009:1.text: Hey, that girl just now... she's a mage, right? Remember the job I mentioned before?
say:15:1660002009:1.source_cn: 老板娘，刚刚那个人是魔法师吗？你还记得我之前跟你提过的...

say:16:1660002010:1.text: You mean clearing the Hypofiends on the trade route? Yeah, not happening right now. Roads are blocked, and the guards are stretched thin as it is...
say:16:1660002010:1.source_cn: 啊，是说想让卫兵清除商路上的魔物对吧？不过现在镇上的交...

say:19:1660002012:1.text: You bet. Ever since the snowstorm hit, people have been seeing those things roaming around. No one knows why they keep heading for the northern hills, but caravans still have to pass through there. It's the only route...
say:19:1660002012:1.source_cn: 是啊。自从这场暴风雪开始之后，不少人都说在雪中看到了魔...

say:20:1660002013:1.text: Some say it's the <style="highlight">undead</style>, others think there's a <style="highlight">witch</style> living up there. Either way, something's going on...

say:21:1660002014:1.text: We need someone to deal with it fast... I've got a family to feed, and every day the road's blocked, I'm bleeding coin!
say:21:1660002014:1.source_cn: 得尽快找人除掉魔物才行啊……我做的是小本生意，耽搁不起...

say:22:1660002015:1.text: Hey, that's some sword you're carrying. You're not just here for the hot springs, are you? Listen... you wouldn't happen to be up for a little Hypofiend-clearing, would you? Your friend looks like she knows her way around magic too...
say:22:1660002015:1.source_cn: 话说回来，您身上这把剑可真够气派的……对了！您愿意接下...

say:25:1660002017:1.text: Depends. How much are you paying?

say:26:1660002018:1.text: Uh... th-this much gold? Will that do?

say:27:1660002019:1.text: Storm's bad enough without the Hypofiends. Not exactly tempting...

say:28:1660002020:0.text: Frieren, they need help. And who knows, maybe this gold can get us something useful. Local magic gear, perhaps.
say:28:1660002020:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲，这座城镇上的人们似乎遇到困难了。而且有了这些金...

say:30:1660002022:0.text: You heard her. We'll take care of it. The road will be safe again, you have my word.
say:30:1660002022:0.source_cn: 既然她也这么说了，那清除魔物的委托我们就接下了。一定会...

choice_prompt:31:1660002022.text: You heard her. We'll take care of it. The road will be safe again, you have my word.
choice_prompt:31:1660002022.source_cn: 既然她也这么说了，那清除魔物的委托我们就接下了。一定会让大家能安心通行的。

say:33:1660002023:1.text: You always crack me up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Alright, time for proper introductions.
say:33:1660002023:1.male: You always crack me up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Alright, time for proper introductions.
say:33:1660002023:1.female: You always crack me up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Alright, time for proper introductions.

say:34:1660002024:1.text: These are Frieren and Himmel. They're... not exactly your typical pair of travelers, as you can probably tell.
say:34:1660002024:1.source_cn: 这边的两位就是芙莉莲和辛美尔。他俩的情况似乎有些特殊呢……
say:34:1660002024:1.male: These are Frieren and Himmel. They're... not exactly your typical pair of travelers, as you can probably tell.
say:34:1660002024:1.female: These are Frieren and Himmel. They're... not exactly your typical pair of travelers, as you can probably tell.

say:35:1660002025:1.text: This here's the mage I told you about, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! A legend around here.
say:35:1660002025:1.source_cn: 二位，这位就是我跟你们提起过的，那位厉害得很的魔法师大...
say:35:1660002025:1.male: This here's the mage I told you about, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! A legend around here.
say:35:1660002025:1.female: This here's the mage I told you about, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! A legend around here.

say:36:1660002026:1.text: Mm... that's some impressive magical energy.
say:36:1660002026:1.male: Mm... that's some impressive magical energy.
say:36:1660002026:1.female: Mm... that's some impressive magical energy.

say:37:1660002027:1.text: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.
say:37:1660002027:1.source_cn: 幸会，我和芙莉莲听格尔达老板娘讲了很多你的轶事呢。
say:37:1660002027:1.male: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.
say:37:1660002027:1.female: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.

choice_prompt:38:1660002027.text: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.
choice_prompt:38:1660002027.source_cn: 幸会，我和芙莉莲听格尔达老板娘讲了很多你的轶事呢。
choice_prompt:38:1660002027.male: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.
choice_prompt:38:1660002027.female: A pleasure to finally meet you. Gerda's told us plenty about your work.

say:40:1660002028:1.text: Really? That's more help than I ever expected. Thank you!
say:40:1660002028:1.source_cn: 真的吗？！如果您也愿意帮忙的话，我就没什么可担心的了。
say:40:1660002028:1.male: Really? That's more help than I ever expected. Thank you!
say:40:1660002028:1.female: Really? That's more help than I ever expected. Thank you!

say:41:1660002029:1.text: That's wonderful. And while we're at it, I wouldn't mind seeing how magic works around here.
say:41:1660002029:1.source_cn: 嗯，帮大忙了。我对这个世界的人使用的魔法也很感兴趣，你...
say:41:1660002029:1.male: That's wonderful. And while we're at it, I wouldn't mind seeing how magic works around here.
say:41:1660002029:1.female: That's wonderful. And while we're at it, I wouldn't mind seeing how magic works around here.

say:42:1660002030:1.text: Yeah! Think you could show us a few things?
say:42:1660002030:1.source_cn: 其实，我也有不少事想向你请教。
say:42:1660002030:1.male: Yeah! Think you could show us a few things?
say:42:1660002030:1.female: Yeah! Think you could show us a few things?

say:44:1660002031:1.text: Well, don't just stand there chatting in the cold. Come inside!
say:44:1660002031:1.source_cn: 那么，大家就别在外面傻站着啦！到暖和的屋子里坐着聊如何？

choice:38:0:1.text: I can help with the Hypofiends as well.
choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 讨伐魔物的事，我也可以帮忙
choice:38:0:1.male: I can help with the Hypofiends as well.
choice:38:0:1.female: I can help with the Hypofiends as well.

choice:31:0:1.text: Ugh, you beat me to it.
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 我是不是错过了大赚一笔的机会？
choice:31:0:1.male: Ugh, you beat me to it.
choice:31:0:1.female: Ugh, you beat me to it.

choice:31:1:2.text: I missed the chance to make a fortune...
choice:31:1:2.male: I missed the chance to make a fortune...
choice:31:1:2.female: I missed the chance to make a fortune...

choice:12:0:1.text: Well... that's one way to shovel snow.
choice:12:0:1.male: Well... that's one way to shovel snow.
choice:12:0:1.female: Well... that's one way to shovel snow.

choice:12:1:2.text: They definitely aren't your average guests.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 真是收留了不得了的旅客啊
choice:12:1:2.male: They definitely aren't your average guests.
choice:12:1:2.female: They definitely aren't your average guests.
